calls.title: IKEA Professional Services
calls.summary: The team outlined a professional services strategy, defining four main service categories: strategic consulting, training, solutions engineering, and managed services, each aimed at generating new revenue. Training is designed to guide clients in processes without prescribing changes, while managed services could significantly increase support costs as demonstrated by IKEA's substantial annual expenditure on support. Discussions centered on the pricing model, weighing hourly rates against fixed or percentage-based fees, with an initial hourly rate proposal raising concerns about bandwidth. They also considered embedding baseline support in the platform fee to avoid revenue loss. The urgency of finalizing these details was stressed due to an imminent RFP submission deadline.
calls.keywords: IKEA, professional services, pricing model, support tiers, training enablement, RFP submission
